title: skills: teach action.pressed in the objectstack-ui actions rule
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28235 (#27946), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the claim template requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: an AI author writing a toggle-style header action from the `objectstack-ui` skill does not learn `pressed`.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` teaches `pressed`: an expression over `record` and `user` that marks the action as already done by this reader; a per-reader fact on a child record reaches it through `attachedOnRead` plus an `afterFind` hook that attaches it to the served row.
- Lands with or after the console card for #27946, so the skill never teaches a key that draws nothing. Governed path (`skills/**`): Tier H.

Links back: #27946, PR #28235.

Blocked-by: #28242
